subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persisted default for TUI provider delivery, or keep `openclaw tui --deliver` as a launch-only opt-in?
rationale: The implementation would add a new config/default surface, and OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config keys even when the user friction is real.

options.title: Approve a narrow TUI delivery default
options.body: Add a canonical config key, document flag-overrides-config behavior, and cover config parsing plus TUI send behavior with focused tests.

options.title: Keep launch-only delivery
options.body: Close or defer the config request and improve docs/status text so users understand when `--deliver` is needed.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow TUI delivery default
recommendation.body: Add a canonical config key, document flag-overrides-config behavior, and cover config parsing plus TUI send behavior with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history points to Peter Steinberger as the strongest TUI/config routing candidate and original Gateway TUI author.
